responsibility: Declares the generic IPA reference-list representation used to record loads, stores, address-taken uses, and aliases between symbol-table nodes. It defines ipa_ref_use, the ipa_ref record linking referring and referred symtab nodes plus statement/LTO/speculation metadata, and ipa_ref_list containers and helpers for forward and reverse traversal. This header supplies the common reference-edge data model used throughout cgraph, varpool, and IPA analyses.
same_name_distinction: Defines the generic symbol-table reference-edge representation—ipa_ref_use, ipa_ref, and ipa_ref_list—used throughout cgraph/varpool, whereas ipa-ref.cc only provides the basic methods on those structures and ipa-reference.* is a separate analysis pass.
